title: Tracker noise for a lone particle: white, Gaussian, sd 0.050 per coordinate, species-independent, no wall clipping

claims.statement: For a single particle, the tracker's reported position minus the noise-free position is zero-mean, white and Gaussian-shaped, with standard deviation 0.050 per coordinate (pooled sd 0.0502 over 28,014 residuals from 7 runs; kurtosis 3.02; mean -0.00005; lag-1 autocorrelation at most 0.024 with standard error about 0.022).
The noise sd does not depend on species at one particle: per-coordinate sd 0.0505 for A (20,010 residuals, 4 runs), 0.0499 for B (4,002, one run), 0.0493 for C (4,002, one run); spread 2.4%.

No wall clipping: a lone A particle at (0.05, 5.0) reports x < 0 in 335 of 2001 samples (17%), and its residual mean is -0.0000 (standard error 0.0012) with sd 0.0516 in x and 0.0499 in y. The tracker does not censor at x = 0.
